purpose: Independent validation recording for frozen candidate v2

action_plan.name: Empty camera view
action_plan.instruction: Remain completely outside the camera view

action_plan.name: Look at camera centre
action_plan.instruction: Sit normally and look directly at the lens

action_plan.name: Look left of camera
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed LEFT marker

action_plan.name: Look right of camera
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed RIGHT marker

action_plan.name: Look above camera
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed ABOVE marker

action_plan.name: Look below camera
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed BELOW marker

action_plan.name: Centre gaze while moving left and right
action_plan.instruction: Keep looking at lens; move body slowly left/right

action_plan.name: Centre gaze while moving closer and farther
action_plan.instruction: Keep looking at lens; move slowly closer/farther

note: Categorical action labels are available; physical target angles were not measured.
